name: Time Wise Sales
query:
WITH intervals(label, sequence, start_hour) AS (
    VALUES
        ('12 AM - 02 AM', 1, 0), ('02 AM - 04 AM', 2, 2),
        ('04 AM - 06 AM', 3, 4), ('06 AM - 08 AM', 4, 6),
        ('08 AM - 10 AM', 5, 8), ('10 AM - 12 PM', 6, 10),
        ('12 PM - 02 PM', 7, 12), ('02 PM - 04 PM', 8, 14),
        ('04 PM - 06 PM', 9, 16), ('06 PM - 08 PM', 10, 18),
        ('08 PM - 10 PM', 11, 20), ('10 PM - 12 AM', 12, 22)
)
SELECT
    intervals.label AS "Time Interval",
    COALESCE(SUM(invoice."grand_total"), 0) AS "Sales",
    COUNT(invoice."name") AS "Bills"
FROM intervals
LEFT JOIN "tabPOS Invoice" invoice ON (
    FLOOR(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM invoice."posting_time") / 2) * 2 = intervals.start_hour
    AND invoice."posting_date" = %(date)s::date
    AND invoice."branch" = %(branch)s
    AND invoice."docstatus" = 1
    AND invoice."status" IN ('Consolidated', 'Paid')
)
GROUP BY intervals.label, intervals.sequence
ORDER BY intervals.sequence
